WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
q3 AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, cs.region, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d   ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25') AND d.fiscal_quarter = 3
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT ty.region, ty.net_sales AS fy2025_26_q3, ly.net_sales AS fy2024_25_q3,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 1) AS growth_pct
FROM q3 ty
JOIN q3 ly ON ly.region = ty.region AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
ORDER BY ty.region;

SELECT 'sales' AS tbl, count(*) AS n_rows, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS d_id, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS d_receipt_line,
       count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) AS n_loads, min(sale_date) AS mn, max(sale_date) AS mx
FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2026-01-25'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'returns', count(*), count(DISTINCT return_line_id), count(DISTINCT sales_line_id), 0, min(return_date), max(return_date)
FROM fact_return_line WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2026-01-25'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'web_orders', count(*), count(DISTINCT web_order_id), 0, 0, min(order_ts_utc)::DATE, max(order_ts_utc)::DATE FROM fact_web_order

WITH dup AS (
  SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*) > 1
)
SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sale_date, f.store_key, f.product_key, f.channel_code, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.gross_amount, f.etl_loaded_at,
       count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY f.receipt_id, f.line_no) AS copies
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dup USING (receipt_id, line_no)
ORDER BY f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sales_line_id
LIMIT 24

WITH dup AS (
  SELECT receipt_id, line_no, count(*) AS c, count(DISTINCT sale_date) AS dd, count(DISTINCT net_amount) AS dn, count(DISTINCT product_key) AS dp, count(DISTINCT store_key) AS ds, count(DISTINCT quantity) AS dq,
         min(sale_date) AS sd, min(etl_loaded_at) AS l1, max(etl_loaded_at) AS l2
  FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*) > 1
)
SELECT c, dd, dn, dp, ds, dq, count(*) AS n_keys, min(sd) AS first_sale, max(sd) AS last_sale, min(l1) AS first_load, max(l2) AS last_load,
       sum(CASE WHEN l1 = l2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS same_load
FROM dup GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY n_keys DESC

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
mine AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, n.store_id, SUM(n.net_sales) AS mine
    FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25') AND d.fiscal_quarter = 3
    GROUP BY 1, 2
),
ctl AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, r.store_id, SUM(r.net_sales) AS ctl
    FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25') AND d.fiscal_quarter = 3
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT COALESCE(m.fiscal_year, c.fiscal_year) AS fy, COALESCE(m.store_id, c.store_id) AS store_id, m.mine, c.ctl, ROUND(COALESCE(m.mine,0) - COALESCE(c.ctl,0), 2) AS diff
FROM mine m FULL JOIN ctl c ON m.fiscal_year = c.fiscal_year AND m.store_id = c.store_id
WHERE ABS(COALESCE(m.mine,0) - COALESCE(c.ctl,0)) > 0.05
ORDER BY ABS(COALESCE(m.mine,0) - COALESCE(c.ctl,0)) DESC

SELECT d.fiscal_year, SUM(r.net_sales) AS ctl_total, count(DISTINCT r.store_id) AS stores,
       count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cs.store_id IS NULL THEN r.store_id END) AS stores_without_current_version,
       SUM(CASE WHEN r.store_id = 999 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rows_999
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.business_date
LEFT JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = r.store_id AND cs.is_current
WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25') AND d.fiscal_quarter = 3
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
